# Logan Goodwin

Official personal website of Logan Goodwin: author, songwriter, technologist, humorist, and independent commentator.

Primary sections:
- /about/ — biography and brand overview
- /books/ — featured books, direct title links, and Frontline Publishing genre pathways
- /music/ — selected original songs
- /commentary/ — commentary and humor
- /technology/ — cybersecurity and technology portfolio
- /videos/ — official channels and featured videos
- /contact/ — contact form

Publishing catalog:
- Frontline Publishing — Books, Audiobooks & Story Media by Logan Goodwin
- https://frontlinetechconsulting.com/
- Genres: science fiction, horror and Wrong Realities, dark fantasy and paranormal romance, comedy and satire, technology and practical guides, and audiobooks
